The supplementary indicator to 10b (Supplerende indikator til 10b: Mortalitet indenfor 30 dage efter akut kirurgi, hvis Charlson Score = 1 eller 2. Alle opererede) tracks 30-day mortality following acute surgery for patients with a Charlson Comorbidity Index score of 1 or 2, providing a risk-adjusted view of surgical outcomes across [[danmark|Denmark]] [^src1]. In the most recent reporting period, the national mortality rate stood at 11.2%, reflecting a steady improvement from 14.4% in 2020/21 and 13.8% in 2021/22 [^src1]. 

Despite the national decline, performance varies drastically at the regional and hospital levels. [[holbaek-sygehus|Holbæk Sygehus]] recorded the highest mortality rate among major hospitals at 25.0%, followed by [[regionshospital-nordjylland|Regionshospital Nordjylland]] at 20.0% and [[regionshospitalet-horsens|Regionshospitalet Horsens]] at 18.8% [^src1]. At the regional level, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] reported the highest mortality rates at 17.1% and 15.6%, respectively [^src1]. Conversely, the lowest mortality rates were observed at [[bornholms-hospital|Bornholms Hospital]] (0.0%, though based on a very small denominator of 7 patients), [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] (5.2%), and [[bispebjerg-og-frederiksberg-hospitaler|Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospitaler]] (6.0%) [^src1]. [[nykoebing-f-sygehus|Nykøbing F Sygehus]] reported a 100.0% mortality rate, but this is a statistical outlier driven by a suppressed, minimal patient volume (denoted as #/#) [^src1].

No entity met the predefined quality standard, as the "Standard opfyldt" (standard met) column registers 0 across all national, regional, and hospital-level entries [^src1]. 

Historical trends reveal significant volatility and notable turnarounds at specific institutions. [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] demonstrated the most dramatic improvement, plummeting from a concerning 33.3% in 2020/21 and 36.4% in 2021/22 down to 10.0% in the current period [^src1]. Similarly, [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] improved markedly from 19.6% in 2021/22 to 5.2% [^src1]. However, some facilities experienced worsening outcomes after prior improvements; for instance, [[holbaek-sygehus|Holbæk Sygehus]] dropped from 37.1% in 2020/21 to 22.9% in 2021/22, but rebounded to 25.0% in the latest period [^src1].
